description: Two-tone third-order intermodulation and IP3 (conventions: Two-tone intermodulation; ADR 0107).

cases.source: by hand: y = x - 0.05x^3 on cos + 0.5 cos: products (3/4)a3 A1^2 A2 and A1 A2^2
by hand: y = x + 0.2|x|^2 x on 0.5(e^{jw1n} + e^{jw2n}): tones 0.575, products 0.025, at 2f1 - f2 = -330 and 2f2 - f1 = 360
f2 must be at most sample_rate/2
f1 falls in the DC group (half-width 4)
f2's bin is inside the f1 group
the f2 group has no power
2f1 - f2 = 0 falls in the DC group
2f2 - f1 = 80 folds to 48, inside the f2 group
the spectrum needs at least two samples
